notes: Author-run frozen native-reset evaluation: 1496/2500 successes (59.84%), all 50 tasks x 50 episodes, fixed seeds and registered horizons, no missing or unknown outcomes. Independent derivative of Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365: inherited A1613 rank-16 Action LoRA, then frozen A1613 plus a trained 4,216,839-parameter continuous conditioning branch used at inference. Training fields describe only B2000; full inherited training and data mixture are documented. Eligibility limitation: an earlier 600-pair confirmation versus the original model showed +1 percentage point (95% interval [-2.17,4.17], McNemar p=0.6173); a gain beyond noise is not established and no matched native-reset 2500-episode base or A-only ablation has been run. Request organizer review under the derivative-model requirements; no accepted rank claimed. CPU OSMesa, query-pixel-preserving rendering decimation and context/readback guards are disclosed. Original episode evidence is released; the subsequent portable loader has CPU checks only, not a repeat full-model evaluation.
